mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant renal toxicity and electrolyte wasting, while tretinoin (especially systemic) has teratogenic potential and requires careful renal function monitoring; concurrent use increases nephrotoxicity risk and complicates management of both drugs.
action: Monitor renal function closely and electrolytes regularly; assess whether systemic tretinoin is necessary during amphotericin B therapy; consider alternative antifungal or dermatologic agents if possible.
